findings.title: React 18 → 19 major version behind
findings.detail: package.json pins react and react-dom to ^18.3.1; latest is 19.2.7 (one major behind). devDependencies @types/react@^18.3.12 and @types/react-dom@^18.3.1 also need to be bumped to ^19.
findings.suggested_fix: Bump react, react-dom, @types/react, @types/react-dom to ^19 in package.json and run npm install

findings.title: No build/test CI runs on direct pushes to main
findings.detail: The last 5 CI runs on main are all 'skipped' — they belong to the Claude Code workflow which only fires on PR comments/reviews, not on push events. There is no workflow that runs npm build or npm test on direct commits to main. The pr-checks.yml presumably covers PRs, but merged commits are not re-verified.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a workflow that runs npm install && npm run build && npm run test:run on push to main

findings.title: No source files changed in the last 14 days
findings.detail: git log --since='14 days ago' returned no changed source files. Missing-test audit is not applicable for this run.
